arguments.value: Logan’s Roadhouse agreed to sponsor Southern Racing Promotions’ NASCAR Late Model Stock Car team for the 1998 season. Logan’s was the primary sponsor, and SRP and driver Brad Baker had to prominently feature Logan’s branding, avoid competing sponsors, and manage the team’s public image, car design, uniforms, show car, transporter, and credentials. SRP could also seek additional noncompeting secondary or associate sponsors with Logan’s approval, subject to limits on their visibility. Logan’s paid SRP $80,000 total, partly upfront and partly in monthly installments. The agreement also covered use of trademarks and publicity rights, confidentiality, insurance, releases, termination rights for breach or bad conduct, and included standard legal terms like notices, governing law, severability, and assignment restrictions.
